newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL exchange extends suspensions on four firms.
newsitem.headline: KL exchange extends suspensions on four firms.

text.p: The Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange (KLSE) has extended the trading suspension of four stocks linked in a possible bank merger deal, the national Bernama news agency said on Saturday.

The suspensions of Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank), Kwong Yik Bank Bhd, Rashid Hussain Bhd and DCB Holdings Bhd have been extended by 10 days to November 19 from November 5, the KLSE said in a statement.
The four were first suspended on Oct 21.
The extension was approved by an exchange committee on grounds that Maybank is still negotiating with Rashid, Bernama said.
Officials at the KLSE or the four companies were not immediately available for comment.
